goal: Turn a successful competitive-router runtime qualification into one bounded training experiment where supervision targets the exact runtime route and old-task anchors explicitly teach parent/no-op.

objective.causal: field-selection CE plus margin plus CE on exact runtime route logits targeting relevant edge
objective.preservation: frozen-parent KL plus CE targeting explicit parent/no-op route on TRAIN-only anchors

method_lessons: When ground-truth routing labels exist, supervise the exact runtime control variable rather than a proxy score.
When a shared parent already solves old tasks, make abstention/no-op an explicit labeled route rather than relying only on output distillation.
Do not add generic MoE load balancing when routing has semantic ground truth and compute balancing is not the problem.
After replacing the control plane, test it directly before introducing gradient-surgery or route/expert decoupling mechanisms.
